motivation: Sealed-panel evidence shows unfiltered Bollinger-v2 mean reversion produced PF=0 with all exits via stop_loss and extreme SHORT dominance.
Gross PnL was already negative before costs, so the failure is not primarily a fee/slippage artifact.
Repo already distinguishes regime/range concepts in research inventories; a regime gate that forces stand-aside in strong trends is a material, falsifiable alternative to blind band reversion.
expected_mechanism: Allow mean-reversion band entries only when a predeclared local price/vol regime is classified as range-bound; stand aside (flat) when the regime is classified as strong trend. Direction may be LONG or SHORT only inside the admitted regime; Master-V2 entry_side remains NONE.
distinction_from_failed_bollinger_v2: Mandatory regime admission gate before any entry intent
Explicit stand-aside state outside range regimes
No reuse of sealed Bollinger-v2 parameters as a free search space
Development and selection forbidden on sealed 65-instrument holdout panel
conceptual_entry_logic: Compute a frozen, predeclared regime label from finalized PIT OHLCV only (no lookahead).
If regime != RANGE_BOUND: emit flat / no entry.
If regime == RANGE_BOUND: allow a mean-reversion band entry against local extremes using a single frozen parameter binding ratified later (not in this slice).
conceptual_exit_logic: Exit on mid/mean reversion target, hard stop, or regime transition out of RANGE_BOUND — exactly one frozen exit binding later; no post-hoc choice.
conceptual_invalidation_logic: If independent-development evaluation yields PF < 1.0 after realistic costs, or <50% OOS folds positive, or win-rate/stop-exit share remains structurally stop-dominated without any positive expectancy: terminal reject this hypothesis family without sealed-holdout retune.
allowed_data_and_features: Public read-only OKX linear USDT perpetual OHLCV PT1H
PIT / chronological features derived from mark/close path
Optional public funding later only if separately ratified; not required for initial hypothesis
forbidden_leakage_and_authority_paths: No sealed holdout 2023-08-16..2024-09-01 for development, selection, or tuning
No Master-V2 / Double-Play / risk / sizing / execution authority mutation
No parameter search on evaluation panels
terminal_fail_criteria: PF_net < 1.0 after realistic costs on independent development evaluation
any use of sealed holdout for parameter choice or hypothesis selection
next_required_operator_step: Seal or acquire independent development panel ending before 2023-08-16; then separate GO for binding definition only — still no sealed-holdout tuning
